In a nutshell, this establishment is not reliable; they scratched my car and refused to pay for the damage. Read  below for particulars.

I got a stereo installed to my car a couple of years back and I was really happy with it so when the stereo was broken I dropped by to get a new one. First they installed the stereo but the back camera associated with it did not work; this happened later in the afternoon so they asked me if I can drop by later and they will fix it. Since I get my stuff done here before; I said OK, paid and left. After a couple of calls, I finally managed to arrange a time frame that is suitable for them. I left my car in their care waiting in the Starbucks across the street. After making me wait two hours, they said connecting the camera system requires extra work and extra money so they didn't do it. Feeling tired after waiting that long I just wanted to go home and do not want to deal with them; I went to my car to find a long scratch in my front bumper. When I confront them about it, the owner did not want to take responsibility claiming it happened after they checked out the car and park it in front of their store. He actually claimed that may be another car did it; which is not physically possible.

I have never been to a place who claims no responsibility for the damage happened to your car when they have your car keys! I called the police to get a report  to claim the damage to our insurance but the police did not show up for an hour; I was told the police can come up to our house. Thinking my time is valuable so I can go home than wait there,  I left. The police came up to my house later in the evening and told me that I should not have left the place. So I sucked it up and paid the cost of paint out of my pocket for the damage this people inflicted on my car.

If you do not want drama in your life, do not get your stuff done here. Ironically, I have got the same price quote for the service in another store close to my house, thinking the people working here are more reliable, I took my business to this particular store :)

5 STAR UPDATE AT END OF ORIGINAL REVIEW....I took an 06 Tundra to empire sound Within the last 2 years. Had a new stereo installed along with door speakers. Was told the system would sound better, but it was anything but. Was flat and had no base. I asked what the frequency response was of the speakers. The response I got was, "what is that". So I found a set of speakers with a better frequency response they could install. It helped some but still didn't compare to the factory jbl system. I let it go after they said the jbl amp couldn't be hooked up and would have to use the amp built into the stereo. As I said, this was installed a couple years ago. Lately had to remove the door panels to install exterior door mirrors and found out what kind of installation these people do. The speaker adapter plates didn't fit over the entire opening of the jbl mounts so they just found 2 holes that would line up and used drywall screws to attach the Adapter plate (cracking the original jbl speaker housing)then used drywall screws again to attach the speakers to the adapter plate, which now makes sense why I am not getting very good bass out of my system. There is about a 1/2 gap around half the speaker. I am not saying, don't go to these people. What I am saying is have them explain in detail how they plan on installing speakers and demand to see various stages of the install and the final stage BEFORE they install the door panels. I could have done this kind of work when I was 12 and didn't know anything about stereos. JUST BEWARE, and get details.
This is an update, Hudson from Empire contacted me about review. He stated the installer that originally installed system is no longer  there and to come by so they can fix his screw ups. Hudson definitely made good on his promise. Installer dynamated my doors, installed correct adapters as well as installed baffles. Sealed up the entire area and soldered connections. Went above and beyond by installing a aux/usb port so I no longer have cables hanging down to center console without charge. talked to him about a possible sub later so will DEFINITELY be going back. Hudson really cares about his customers satisfaction. Thanks, Hudson...See you soon.
